children: Overview
Singapore shipyard and chartering group's FY2026 revenue rose 24% to S$152.05 mln
Profit for FY2026 fell 40% to S$40.6 mln
Company proposed a final dividend of S$0.002 per share, up from S$0.0015
Outlook
Marco Polo Marine's proposed sale of its Shipyard Division remains subject to conditions precedent
Plans to deploy its second AHTS in FY2027 under a 15-year Taiwan salvage-vessel contract
Expects delivery of its CSOV Plus vessel in Q2 2028
Result Drivers

IMPAIRMENT REVERSALS – Profit from operations fell to S$50.6 mln from S$71.8 mln as property, plant and equipment impairment reversals dropped to S$2.0 mln from S$22.4 mln, with no joint-venture balance reversal booked
CHARTERING FLEET EXPANSION – Ship-chartering revenue grew on deployment of MP Wind Archer and three additional crew transfer vessels
SHIPYARD CAPACITY – Shipbuilding and repair revenue increased on higher repair-project volumes after Drydock 4 began operating in August 2025
FINANCING COSTS – Finance costs rose as borrowings funded the expanded offshore vessel fleet
